summary: All seven phase-2 success criteria are met. The SKILL.md changes (--refresh Steps R2/R3/R5, --uninstall Steps U3/U7) are logically correct, well-guarded, and match the spec. The hook-restart caveat is present in both required locations. The smoke report findings are all marked resolved/documented. The advanced-planning Fix 1 (fa799d3) is on main.
